Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection II, to be performed 
on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the above title block. (Earthing 
Transformer for units 1,2,3,4)
The first draft initiated by eng. 
Mohammed Abdel Moneim, tested by eng. 
Yasser Abdo, accepted by eng. 
Sayed Mahmoud 
Hussein Farag; general director, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Adel Abd 
El-Qader El-Nagar & eng. Saad Basuony, approved by eng. 
Mokhtar Abdel 
Latif Mady head sector of Ataka PS.
This document accepted by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilil: EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, and quality control general 
director and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must 
 be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category,
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounded the work area is required.
Wear your safety 
 helmet & safety belt when cleaning suspension insulators.
Isolate the 6 kV 
 bus bar.
Starting the cleaning of all porcelain surfaces of all 
 transformer, wear your breathing mask to protect lung tissues from the 
 dust particulate.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send it 
 to the dump.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, 
 safety belt, and tool set
Voltage indicator, 
 Portable earth for discharging on the bus bar.
Fine cloth for 
 cleaning purposes, Silica gel
Complete tool 
 kit/set, including a torque wrench.
Work to be Carried Out
Rearrangement state :Connect all items which are disconnected.
Check for signs 
 of oil leaks.
Check oil level 
 in tank and conservator .
Check the break 
 point of oil.
